scenes.title: tinydb
scenes.text: TinyDB is a tiny, document oriented database optimized for your happiness. It has 14 classes in 7 modules, with 1557 lines of methods. The largest planet is Table, followed by Query. The 51 lines of light between planets are calls and references that cross class boundaries.

scenes.title: TinyDB
scenes.text: TinyDB. The main class of TinyDB. 172 lines, 12 gates, 12 of them public. For the type checker only, it extends Table. It uses Table, Storage and JSONStorage.
scenes.name: TinyDB

scenes.title: Table
scenes.text: Table. Represents a single TinyDB table. 700 lines, 20 gates, 17 of them public. It uses LRUCache, Document, QueryLike and 1 more. It is used by TinyDB.
scenes.name: Table

scenes.title: Document
scenes.text: Document. A document stored in the database. 3 lines, 1 gate, 1 of them public. It is used by Table.
scenes.name: Document

scenes.title: LRUCache
scenes.text: LRUCache. A least-recently used (LRU) cache with a fixed cache size. 48 lines, 10 gates, 10 of them public. It is used by Table.
scenes.name: LRUCache

scenes.title: Query
scenes.text: Query. TinyDB Queries. 335 lines, 22 gates, 21 of them public. It extends QueryInstance. It uses QueryInstance.
scenes.name: Query

scenes.title: QueryInstance
scenes.text: QueryInstance. A query instance. 53 lines, 9 gates, 7 of them public. It is used by Query.
scenes.name: QueryInstance

scenes.title: QueryLike
scenes.text: QueryLike. A typing protocol that acts like a query. 2 lines, 2 gates, 0 of them public. It is used by Table.
scenes.name: QueryLike

scenes.title: Storage
scenes.text: Storage. The abstract base class for all Storages. 26 lines, 3 gates, 3 of them public. It is used by TinyDB, CachingMiddleware, Table and 1 more.
scenes.name: Storage

scenes.title: JSONStorage
scenes.text: JSONStorage. Store the data in a JSON file. 75 lines, 4 gates, 4 of them public. It extends Storage. It is used by TinyDB.
scenes.name: JSONStorage

scenes.title: MemoryStorage
scenes.text: MemoryStorage. Store the data as JSON in memory. 11 lines, 3 gates, 3 of them public. It extends Storage. No lines connect it to other classes.
scenes.name: MemoryStorage

scenes.title: Middleware
scenes.text: Middleware. The base class for all Middlewares. 51 lines, 3 gates, 2 of them public. It uses Storage.
scenes.name: Middleware

scenes.title: CachingMiddleware
scenes.text: CachingMiddleware. Add some caching to TinyDB. 51 lines, 5 gates, 3 of them public. It extends Middleware. It uses Storage.
scenes.name: CachingMiddleware

scenes.title: FrozenDict
scenes.text: FrozenDict. An immutable dictionary. 9 lines, 4 gates, 0 of them public. No lines connect it to other classes.
scenes.name: FrozenDict

scenes.title: TinyDBPlugin
scenes.text: TinyDBPlugin. A plugin for the mypy type checker. This class has no docstring. 21 lines, 2 gates, 0 of them public. No lines connect it to other classes.
scenes.name: TinyDBPlugin

scenes.title: tinydb
scenes.text: That is the whole of tinydb: fourteen classes, held together by lines of light.
